versions.name: Asymmetric Scale-Out & Toxic Asset Purge
versions.summary: Core execution perfection addressing post-v1.2 empirical findings: delisted high-volatility chop assets (HYPE and PUMP, which drove -$39.28 USD in drag), upgraded Dynamic Scale-Out ratio to 33% Partial Take Profit at +1.0R (leaving 67% runner volume to capture full +2.0R expansions), and deployed an autonomous 45-minute per-coin loss cooldown to prevent revenge-trading during chop cycles.
versions.verdict: Active on live production book. 10 curated alpha assets (30 strategy slots), 33/67 asymmetric scale-out profit locking, 45-minute coin loss cooldown, and fee-buffered Breakeven trailing.
changes: Delisted High-Chop Assets: Permanently purged HYPE and PUMP from active universe (isolated -$39.28 USD drag in v1.2 due to 5m wick traps)
Curated 10-Asset Alpha Universe: Book re-balanced across high-conviction performers (WLD, INJ, ZEC, NEAR, ENA, ARB, PAXG, AVAX, TAO, SUI) across 5 clusters
Asymmetric Scale-Out Model (33% @ 1.0R): Recalibrated partial profit ratio from 50% to 33.3%, securing fees and risk-free status while allowing a heavy 66.7% runner to capture full +2.0R expansions
Autonomous Loss Cooldown (45m): Implemented strict per-coin post-stopout timeout (45 minutes) to eliminate rapid consecutive stopouts in erratic consolidation
Refined Correlation Cluster Weights: Normalized capital allocation across 10 assets (w=0.1000 per asset) with max 3 concurrent positions per cluster

config_snapshot.coins: WLD, INJ, ZEC, NEAR, ENA, ARB, PAXG, AVAX, TAO, SUI

notes: Eliminated the two primary profit drains that caused -48% of total v1.2 drawdown.
Asymmetric 33/67 scale-out restores positive profit asymmetry: full TP gains now outweigh partial-only saves by 3.5:1.

versions.name: Dynamic Scale-Out & Calibrated RR
versions.summary: Major risk execution refinement introducing Dynamic Scale-Out (50% Partial Take Profit at +1.0R), calibrated RR target (1:2.0 from 1:3.5), positive fee-buffered Breakeven trailing (+0.15R), and strict 1h counter-trend Short filtering to lock profits before intraday mean-reversion pullbacks.
versions.verdict: Active on live production book. Calibrated 1:2.0 RR target, 50% partial profit lock at 1.0R, fee-buffered Breakeven trailing, and strict 1h multi-timeframe short trend gating.
changes: Calibrated Risk-to-Reward: SMC Silver Bullet scalp target recalibrated from 1:3.5 to 1:2.0 RR (+230% backtested expectancy boost by capturing profits before retrace)
Dynamic Scale-Out Engine: Automated 50% Partial Take Profit at +1.0R (locks realized gains into balance immediately upon momentum expansion)
Fee-Buffered Breakeven Trailing: Breakeven shift now includes a +0.15R positive buffer to eliminate round-trip taker fee (0.09%) and slippage erosion
Strict Multi-Timeframe Short Gating: Short trades strictly forbidden unless 1h higher timeframe confirmed in structural downtrend (closes below EMA 20 and EMA 20 <= EMA 50)
Eliminated False Retracement Drawdown: Stops winning trades (+1R to +1.8R) from round-tripping into full stop-outs during Asian session chop

config_snapshot.coins: WLD, INJ, ZEC, NEAR, HYPE, ENA, PUMP, ARB, PAXG, AVAX, TAO, SUI

notes: Eliminates the Asian session shorting trap where counter-trend bounces wiped floating gains.
50% partial at 1.0R guarantees positive cash flow even if the remainder returns to entry.

versions.name: SMC Silver Bullet & Kinetic Trend
versions.summary: Major algorithmic upgrade integrating Smart Money Concepts (SMC) & ICT quantitative mechanisms alongside HTF breakout momentum across a 12-asset multi-asset universe (including Gold PAXG, AVAX, TAO, SUI). Implements algorithmic Fair Value Gaps (FVG), BSL/SSL Liquidity Sweeps, Market Structure Shifts (MSS), dynamic Trailing Breakeven at +1.5R, and session Killzone filters.
versions.verdict: Active on live production book. 12 assets including Gold (PAXG), 38 strategy slots, aggressive 0.45% base risk model with 6.00% max open risk cap.
changes: smc_lib quantitative engine deployed: Swing pivot fractal detection, BSL/SSL liquidity sweep wick analysis, Displacement identification (>2.0x ATR)
Algorithmic Fair Value Gap (FVG) and Consequent Encroachment (50% midpoint) retest entries
Trailing Breakeven activated: dynamic stop loss shift to entry price once floating unrealized reaches +1.5R
ICT Killzone time integration: London session (14:00-17:00 WIB), NY AM (20:00-23:30 WIB), US Late (03:00-05:00 WIB)
Aggressive Risk Model: Base risk increased from 0.25% to 0.45%, max total open risk expanded to 4.50%
Max total margin ceiling increased to 75% equity
ARB re-added to active portfolio universe (tested PF 1.46 in backtest)
Correlation cluster concurrency expanded to 3 concurrent positions per cluster
Expanded universe to 12 assets: added Gold (PAXG), AVAX, TAO, SUI across 5 correlation clusters
Total strategy slots expanded to 38, max concurrent trades raised to 20
Max total open risk ceiling raised to 6.00% for aggressive sizing
versions.notes: Backtested on 14-day Hyperliquid tick history: SMC engine alone delivered +87.72R net profit with 1.30 Profit Factor across 586 trades.

versions.name: Baseline Breakout
versions.summary: First production release, closed 23 Oct 2026. Single strategy family (breakout) across three horizons on seven coins. Fixed-fractional risk at 0.25% per trade with a 2.25% aggregate open-risk ceiling. Closed out at -9.06% after 157 trades over 74.8 hours of continuous operation.
versions.verdict: Underperformed. Breakout edge did not hold on the live book despite passing validation. Win rate of 25.5% against a 1:4-1:5 reward structure produced a profit factor of 0.78, short of the 1.0 breakeven threshold. Retired rather than patched.
changes: Breakout family only - sweep_fade and bollinger retired after negative out-of-sample performance
Seven coins: WLD, INJ, ZEC, NEAR, HYPE, ENA, PUMP
Three horizons per coin: 5m (RR 1:5), 15m (RR 1:4), 1h (RR 1:4)
Risk 0.25% per trade, 2.25% max aggregate open risk
Correlation clusters capped at 2 concurrent positions
Leverage 10x uniform across all instruments
Daily and weekly loss caps disabled; per-coin cooldown disabled
Closed 23 Oct 2026 with 3 open positions flattened at market
versions.notes: Baseline release. All subsequent versions are measured against this. Post-mortem: 114 stop-outs vs 29 take-profits, 11 time exits. HYPE and ENA accounted for -$47.92 of the -$90.57 net loss.
